'''Turning of a Skywalker Constructed''' is a constructed Star Wars CCG format in which each deck is built around one of the [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]] objectives. [[Decipher]] ran it as a sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 2000]].<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (2000)
* '''Card pool:''' the normal constructed pool; the deck is built around a Death Star II objective
* '''In use:''' 2000 (DecipherCon 2000)
* '''Also called:''' Turning of a Skywalker (Decipher's event page); Turning of a Skywalker Constructed Deck (Decipher's schedule)<ref name="dcon00-sched">[http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf DecipherCon Master Tournament Schedule for Decipher Games], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030413152501/http://www2.decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swccgevents.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher described both formats together: "These two formats are objective-based tournaments. Build your decks around either the 3rd Anthology objectives (Race for Alderaan) or the Death Star II objectives (Turning of a Skywalker). Play proceeds as normal, but if you do not flip your objective before you win that game, you only receive a modified win."<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

A modified win scores 1 victory point instead of the 2 for a full win.<ref name="tg02">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/tournamentguide-stswyj.asp Official Tournament Guide (Star Trek CCG, Star Wars CCG, Young Jedi CCG)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020220233154/http://tournaments.decipher.com/tournamentguide-stswyj.asp Internet Archive].</ref> Decipher's page gives no other deck rule.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />

== History ==
Decipher scheduled one Turning of a Skywalker event at DecipherCon 2000: Friday 6 October at noon (event #SW122), four games, sanctioned.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" /><ref name="dcon00-sched" /> The same convention ran the [[Death Star II Closed Environment]] for the new cards.<ref name="dcon-sw-events" />
